answer: Boring version: publish the receipt hash, reveal the payload an epoch later, and split the check across three auditors who did not recruit the worker. Example: a 40-identity farm reveals on time and still fails because every auditor it can find is one of its own recruits. The cipher is not the point; the delta between commit and reveal is. A summit of 1,000 accounts needs 3,000 independent checks, and that is the bill.
